requestFailureAnalysis.interpretation: All1370 captured failed requests were same-origin RSC fetches canceled with net::ERR_ABORTED. Follow-up diagnostic captured13 canceled RSC requests with next-router-prefetch:1 headers; consistent with cancellation of speculative prefetch during menu and route changes. No pageerrors or non-RSC failed requests were observed; no external request was attempted. Original bulk request headers were not captured, so cancellation timing is not independently proven for each original request.
